from collections import deque
R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if grid[r][c]!=7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   q=deque([(r,c)]);seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft();pts.append((x,y))
    for nx,ny in ((x+1,y),(x-1,y),(x,y+1),(x,y-1)):
     if 0<=nx<R and 0<=ny<C and grid[nx][ny]!=7 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
      seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
   vals={grid[x][y] for x,y in pts if grid[x][y]!=0 and grid[x][y]!=3}
   comps.append((min(x for x,y in pts),max(x for x,y in pts),min(y for x,y in pts),max(y for x,y in pts),vals,len(pts)))
comps
